description: This file is a server-side JavaScript application using Express.js to provide a web API for visualizing and testing database connections across multiple database types (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, MongoDB). It includes classes for database adapters, configuration loading from environment files, and API route handlers.

classes.name: DatabaseAdapter
classes.description: Abstract base class for database adapters, providing interface methods for testing connection, retrieving tables, and fetching data.

classes.name: SQLAdapter
classes.description: Abstract class extending DatabaseAdapter, providing common SQL query execution methods.

classes.name: PostgresAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for PostgreSQL, implementing methods to query table names and data.

classes.name: MySQLAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for MySQL, implementing methods to query table names and data.

classes.name: SQLiteAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for SQLite, implementing methods to query table names and data, and test connection.

classes.name: MongoDBAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for MongoDB, implementing methods to list collections and retrieve data.

methods.name: loadEnvFiles
methods.description: Loads environment variables from .env files for different database types.

methods.name: testConnections
methods.description: Tests connections to configured databases and reports which are available.

methods.name: handleApiRequest
methods.description: Generic handler for API requests, executing operations on specified database adapters.
